apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.0 — Two device-reported fixes, reworked. LoopLab: tapping Edit on a loop's Swaras now pushes the editor — the push is registered at the library stack root (the shape Compose uses), not inside the pushed song page. Song detail waveform: the touch forwarding is rebuilt on explicit view probes instead of hierarchy guessing, and is covered by new tests that exercise the hit-testing in a real window — Follow, Fit, the loop badge, tap-seek and pinch receive touches while the page rests at the top; scrolling is unchanged.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
